_tables: state 0 shifts token 5 into state 1 (actions at index 1), state 1 shifts 5 into state 2 (index 3); states 2..8 have no shifts (index 0 = -2), so each case's parseDefaultRules[2..] (0x1009d9c8+2s) picks the rule(s) to reduce. Goto table entries 1000..1011 send a chained rule (ruleGotos = 1000+2i, length 0) to state 3+i. Stacks start 0x100/0x400 into their objects so pops below the base stay mapped; value slot V+0x20/V+0x30 = parser token value (parser+0xc), V = valueStack+0x400
_ignore_writes: rules that store the address of a frame local (a list, a face record) in the rule value reduce with length 0 and then accept (state 3 -> rule 0), so that address lands only in value slot V+0x40; the two frames differ, so that dword is not compared
